calls.input: You want a haircut at Sage and Stone on Tuesday at eleven in the morning. Your phone number is +34 671 540 105. Say it as "plus three four, six seven one, five four zero, one zero five", and say yes when it is read back. When the receptionist reads back the Tuesday booking, do not say yes or no: ask "Before I answer, what time do you open on Saturdays?". After they answer, say "No, don't book that one.". After they reply, say "What about Tuesday at two in the afternoon?". Say yes when that booking is read back. When they confirm it, say "Sorry, could you repeat that?". When they have repeated it, say "Can you move it to Wednesday at the same time?". Say yes when the move is read back. When the move is confirmed and they ask if there is anything else, say "No, that's all, thanks" and say goodbye.
expected_behaviors: The agent answered the Saturday opening-hours question without booking Tuesday at 11:00 AM.
After the caller said not to book it, nothing was booked for Tuesday at 11:00 AM.
The agent read back a haircut on Tuesday the 29th at 2:00 PM, and the caller said yes before the agent said it was booked.
When the caller asked the agent to repeat, the agent repeated the confirmation of Tuesday at 2:00 PM.
The agent read back a move of that appointment to Wednesday the 30th at 2:00 PM, and the caller said yes before the agent said it was moved.
